fields.subject: The notice's subject, e.g. "Afiax invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00012 is overdue".
fields.headline: The heading in the email.
fields.message: What happened, in one or two sentences, with the amount and date in words.
fields.tenantId: The organisation ID, to quote when there is no invoice.
fields.invoiceNumber: Optional. The invoice the notice is about.
fields.amount: Optional. Amount due in KES, formatted, e.g. 6,960.
fields.showPay: true when there is something to pay.
fields.mpesaAccount: The account number for the paybill: the invoice number, or the organisation ID.
fields.billingUrl: The portal's Bills and payments page.
fields.next: Optional. What happens next, with the date, stated as a fact.

overdue.subject: Afiax invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00012 is overdue
overdue.headline: Your invoice is overdue
overdue.message: Invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00012 for KES 6,960 was due on 19 Nov 2026 and hasn't been paid yet.
overdue.next: If it is still unpaid on 10 Dec 2026, Afiax becomes read-only for Mama Pharmacy: your team can still sign in, read and export, but not add or change records.

trial-ending.subject: Your Afiax trial ends in 7 days
trial-ending.preview: Your subscription then starts at KES 6,000 a month plus VAT.
trial-ending.headline: Your trial ends on 19 Dec 2026
trial-ending.message: Your free trial ends in 7 days. Your subscription then starts at KES 6,000 a month plus VAT; you can change this under Bills and payments.
